name: Nobie
description: Provides an Excel-compatible spreadsheet runtime built for agents and humans to share, so agents can read, compute and write real workbooks from the command line.

skills.name: Workbook Computation
skills.description: Evaluates Excel-compatible formulas and recalculates dependent cells so agent edits produce correct results.

skills.name: Programmatic Cell Editing
skills.description: Reads and writes ranges in existing workbooks from the CLI without breaking formatting or formula references.

skills.name: Human-Agent Handoff
skills.description: Keeps one file editable by both a person in the GUI and an agent at the command line on the same model.
